Introducing Thinkproject Platform
 Pioneering a new era and offering a cohesive alternative to the fragmented landscape of construction software, Thinkproject seamlessly integrates the most extensive portfolio of mature solutions with an innovative platform, providing unparalleled features, integrations, user experiences, and synergies.
By combining information management expertise and in-depth knowledge of the building, infrastructure, and energy industries, Thinkproject empowers customers to efficiently deliver, operate, regenerate, and dispose of their built assets across their entire lifecycle through a Connected Data Ecosystem.
What your day will look like
As our Professional Services Partner, participate in the maintenance, evolution, and development of technology solutions for the PLM product. And contribute to continuous improvement and software enhancement that meet customer requirements.
 Main Responsibilities
Technical specifications: Write detailed technical specifications.
Software maintenance: Corrective and evolutionary software maintenance.
Enhancement: Develop new features in PLM based on customer requirements
Integration testing: Perform integration and acceptance tests.
Specific development: Carry out specific developments for customers.
Estimation: Support the Technical Consultant by analyzing and estimating the effort needed for specific customer requests
